folder.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production desktop icon PNG for a 1990s Macintosh System 7 inspired personal portfolio. Subject: one open project folder with three slightly offset paper sheets inside, no text or other symbols. Create one centered isolated icon only. Style: expertly hand-pixelled classic 32-by-32-pixel color Macintosh icon, enlarged perfectly with nearest-neighbor square pixels; hard one-pixel dark charcoal outline, restrained light-grey folder with a muted periwinkle blue front face, white top-left highlights, medium-gray lower-right edge, a tiny stepped hard drop shadow. Strong readable silhouette, simple early 1990s GUI pictogram, only 8 flat colors, selective checkerboard dithering on one shadow edge. No antialiasing or blur, no gradient, no modern glossy 3D, no rounded app tile, no surrounding frame, no emoji style. Composition: icon centered occupying about 80 percent of square canvas, equal margins; all pixels aligned to a consistent logical 32px grid. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no backdrop, no labels, no watermark. Output: a PNG icon.
